events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas, aged 25.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Twenty-five years on, we remember the profound impact of Tupac Shakur. A true icon whose music continues to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, he would have been 84.

angles.name: Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger.

events.title: John Lennon Released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-one years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that continues to inspire hope and peace around the world.

events.title: Apple Released The First iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed the game for music lovers everywhere. What was on your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what are your standout tracks?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, he would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. Forever a legend.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980, he would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message for peace continue to resonate globally.
